notes.title: Options Update
notes.content: There is now a new options menu on title screen, where you can change the sound volume, the screen resolution and switch between fullscreen and windowed mode.

notes.title: Little Update
notes.content: In Main Menu there is now an option to change the volume of the capsule sound and of the music

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Long time nothing happened to capsule jump, but right now I decided to update this game and add quality of life content.

1. In all standard levels you can now open a menu when pressing on escape button, where you can restart the level, go back to level menu or just quit the application
2. If you now complete a level it will be always highlighted in level select.

I am always happy about improvement ideas.

So happy jumping to yall, don't tilt, and be ready for upcoming update
